title: Guard the self-build contract literal in the form Susi Commercial Apps reads from a checkout
goal: Vision: V-4. Susi Commercial Apps links no core crate; it now wraps delegated prompts with the contract it reads from the checkout's own crates/susi-core/src/self_build.rs instead of a copied header that nothing kept in step. Guard on core's side that the BRIEF literal stays in the plain form that reader accepts and that reading it gives exactly the compiled contract.

reuse.searched: crates/susi-core/src/self_build.rs and its unit tests, the mandate guards in tests/architecture_tests.rs, and the reader added to susi-commercial-apps (crates/susi-commercial-license/src/substrate_compat.rs, susi_core::self_build::checkout_contract). The guard is one more test beside the existing self-build and mandate guards and reads the literal the same way the commercial reader does; no new file, module or dependency.

limitations: One test; no runtime change. Main is unqualified development, not a release.

The guard keeps core's literal readable and equal to the compiled contract. It does not run the commercial reader itself: the two repositories do not build together. The commercial suite has its own test that reads this checkout's real contract when a core checkout sits beside it.
Test Rust is now 128,995 of its 129,000-line ceiling; no ceiling was changed for this.
